purpose: Create the canonical long-form local result ledger only from independently accepted three-seed WorldMemArena evidence, without manual score transcription or source-reported values.

supersession.historical_file_rule: Keep v1 unchanged because prior registry and table freezes bind its zero-row state.

metric_catalog.use: metric keys and predeclared directions only; all numeric cells were empty at freeze

negative_controls: raw aggregate versus combined summary value mismatch

admission.summary: TERMINAL_ACCEPTED complete three-seed method summary with seeds 0, 1, and 2
admission.seed_roots: three independently inventoried TERMINAL_ACCEPTED aggregate roots
admission.raw_value_check: Every promoted value must exactly equal both the corresponding seed aggregate metric and the same seed value in the combined summary.
admission.identity_check: Dataset digest and benchmark code commit must match every seed audit; method identity must exist and be executable in the frozen 30-row matrix.
admission.result_granularity: one row per implementation, model seed, and each of 55 predeclared method-level metrics

retention.canonical_csv: reproduced-results.v2.csv inside a fresh immutable admission bundle
retention.raw_aggregate_and_slice_artifacts: retain in the independently archived method evidence; the 55-row-per-seed ledger is an index, not a replacement

prohibited: manually copying a paper or README value into the local ledger
admitting fewer than all three registered seeds
admitting a partial denominator, failed sample, blocked method, or proposed method
changing a metric direction or excluding a frozen metric after seeing results
treating three seeds as 450 independent benchmark samples
